name: Juniper

character.name: Juniper
character.one_liner: Clever, a little smug, always three steps ahead.
character.visual: Bright orange fox kit with a white face, a tuft of fur on top, raised eyebrows, and a sly delighted grin

tagline: Already three steps ahead. Try to keep up.
blurb: Juniper figured out the plan before you finished explaining it, and is very pleased about that. Entertainment only — not financial advice.

design.layout_label: Centered stack — mascot above copy in one rounded card

lore:
Juniper solved the riddle before the riddle was finished. Juniper found the shortcut, the hidden snack stash, and the way back home — then waited, grinning, for everyone else to catch up.

That little tuft on top stands up whenever an idea lands, which is often. The eyebrows do the rest of the talking.

A bit smug? Sure. But Juniper always saves you a seat at the front. Clever friends are the best friends. Entertainment only — not financial advice.
